mapper.select:
SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.barcode AS barcode, g.name AS name, g.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, u.name AS unitName, g.spec AS spec, g.is_weighed AS isWeighed, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(inv.cost_price, 0) AS costPrice, COALESCE(inv.cost_amount, 0) AS costAmount, g.retail_price AS retailPrice, g.safety_stock_lower AS safetyStockLower, g.safety_stock_upper AS safetyStockUpper, CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN 'OUT' WHEN g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper THEN 'OVERSTOCK' WHEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS stockStatus, inv.last_change_time AS lastChangeTime FROM goods g JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id JOIN unit u ON u.id = g.unit_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.goods_id = g.id
ORDER BY
g.goods_code g.name COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) COALESCE(inv.cost_amount, 0) inv.last_change_time inv.last_change_time
ASC DESC
, g.id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inv.cost_amount), 0) FROM goods g LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.goods_id = g.id

g.status = 1

AND g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper
AND ( COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= 0 OR (COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower AND (g.safety_stock_upper IS NULL OR COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) < g.safety_stock_upper)) OR (g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper) )

mapper.sql: CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN g.safety_stock_lower - COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) WHEN g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper THEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) - g.safety_stock_upper ELSE g.safety_stock_lower - COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) END
mapper.select:
SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.barcode AS barcode, g.name AS name, g.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, u.name AS unitName, g.spec AS spec, g.is_weighed AS isWeighed, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) AS quantity, g.safety_stock_lower AS safetyStockLower, g.safety_stock_upper AS safetyStockUpper, CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN 'OUT' WHEN g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper THEN 'OVERSTOCK' ELSE 'WARNING' END AS alertType, AS gapQty, inv.last_change_time AS lastChangeTime FROM goods g JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id JOIN unit u ON u.id = g.unit_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.goods_id = g.id
ORDER BY
COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) g.goods_code g.name inv.last_change_time
ASC DESC
, g.id DESC

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS outCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower AND (g.safety_stock_upper IS NULL OR COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) < g.safety_stock_upper) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS warningCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS overstockCount FROM goods g LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.goods_id = g.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (goods_id, store_id, quantity, cost_price, cost_amount, last_change_time, version) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{storeId}, 0, 0, 0, NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE goods_id = goods_id
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET cost_amount = ROUND((quantity + #{qty}) * cost_price, 2), quantity = quantity + #{qty}, last_change_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND store_id = #{storeId}

UPDATE inventory SET quantity = #{quantity}, cost_price = #{costPrice}, cost_amount = #{costAmount}, last_change_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.sql: SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) AS bookQty, COALESCE(rec.total_qty, 0) AS recordQty, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) - COALESCE(rec.total_qty, 0) AS diffQty, COALESCE(inv.cost_price, 0) AS costPrice, inv.last_change_time AS lastChangeTime, CASE WHEN inv.goods_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rowMissing FROM goods g JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.goods_id = g.id AND inv.store_id = #{storeId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, SUM(change_qty) AS total_qty FROM inventory_record WHERE store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY goods_id ) rec ON rec.goods_id = g.id
mapper.select: WHERE COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <> COALESCE(rec.total_qty, 0) ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) - COALESCE(rec.total_qty, 0)) DESC, g.id
WHERE COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <> COALESCE(rec.total_qty, 0) ORDER BY g.id
